design_gotchas.title: SOT-23-5 (DBV) Pinout Matches TLV9001/OPA333 DBV — Differs from SC70 (DCK) & U-Variants
design_gotchas.detail: TLV9061IDBVR uses TI standard SOT-23-5 DBV ordering (1=OUT, 2=V-, 3=IN+, 4=IN-, 5=V+), matching TLV9001IDBVR and OPA333AIDBVR. Do NOT confuse it with TLV9061IDCKR (SC70-5) or LMV321/TLV9001U DBV layouts where pins 1, 3, and 4 are permuted (1=IN+, 3=IN-, 4=OUT).

design_gotchas.title: 10 MHz GBWP Demands Local Supply Decoupling and Capacitive-Load Isolation
design_gotchas.detail: Dropping the 10 MHz TLV9061IDBVR into a slower 1 MHz TLV9001 or 350 kHz OPA333 PCB requires a tight 0.1 µF ceramic bypass capacitor across pins 2 and 5 and an isolation resistor for capacitive loads above 100 pF to prevent excessive overshoot or oscillation.

design_gotchas.title: 6.0 V Abs Max Supply Ceiling and 9x Higher Quiescent Current vs TLV9001IDBVR
design_gotchas.detail: TLV9061IDBVR is capped at 6.0 V absolute maximum (vs 7.0 V on TLV9001IDBVR and OPA333AIDBVR) and draws 538 µA typ (750 µA max) compared to 60 µA on TLV9001 and 17 µA on OPA333, significantly impacting ultra-low-power battery budgets.

design_gotchas.title: Complementary RRIO Input Stage Crossover Reduces Full-Range CMRR
design_gotchas.detail: Typical CMRR is 103 dB (80 dB min) for VCM < (V+) - 1.4 V, but drops to 87 dB typ (57 dB min) across the full rail-to-rail input range as the NMOS/PMOS input pairs hand off near V+ - 1.4 V.

engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments TLV9061IDBVR is a 10 MHz, 6.5 V/µs, rail-to-rail input and output (RRIO) single CMOS operational amplifier in a 5-pin SOT-23 (DBV) package operating from 1.8 V to 5.5 V (-40°C to 125°C). Featuring ±0.3 mV typical offset (±1.6 mV max), ultra-low 0.5 pA input bias current, 10 nV/√Hz broadband noise at 10 kHz (16 nV/√Hz at 1 kHz), and ±50 mA short-circuit drive, it shares the exact TI DBV SOT-23-5 pinout (1=OUT, 2=V-, 3=IN+, 4=IN-, 5=V+) with TLV9001IDBVR and OPA333AIDBVR while delivering 10x higher bandwidth at 538 µA quiescent current.
